schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE R (A INT, B INT);
q1: SELECT X.A, SUM(X.A + X.B) FROM R AS X GROUP BY X.A
q2: SELECT Y.A, SUM(Y.A + Y.B) FROM R AS Y GROUP BY Y.A
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT X.A, SUM(X.A + X.B) FROM R AS X GROUP BY X.A
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT Y.A, SUM(Y.A + Y.B) FROM R AS Y GROUP BY Y.A
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are semantically identical. They both select column A from table R, group by A, and compute the sum of (A + B) for each group. The only difference is the alias used for the table (X in Q1 and Y in Q2), which has no impact on the result.
